title: 第5章 应激的陆穿
content_zh:
“太郎，你这么着急找我做什么？”

    谷川看着陆穿，有点不太高兴。

    他差点就帮太郎找到女演员了，结果被陆穿好几个电话，给催了过来。

    “能不能不要叫我太郎？”陆穿说道。

    我不是你那个日本同学。

    “知道了太郎。”谷川点头。

    陆穿牙疼。

    算了，随便他怎么叫吧。

    陆穿开始聊正事：“那个《女巫布莱克》，真的能叫电影吗？”

    他看过了，还看了好几遍，感觉都是在浪费自己的生命。

    粗糙的画质，手持DV拍摄，全片几乎都在剧烈晃动，晃得人想吐。

    剧情故弄玄虚，没有逻辑。

    但这样的一部电影，确实取得了超高的电影票房。

    “咳咳，虽然这部电影有一些小瑕疵，但不能否认，这是一部优秀的电影。”谷川说道。

    在谷川看来，能赚钱的电影，它就是优秀的。

    陆穿不明白，这电影到底优秀在哪了。

    “咳咳，伪纪录片的开山鼻祖嘛，粗糙一点很正常。”谷川说道：“就算是粗糙成这样，票房都那么高，我们拍的好点，票房不得爆炸啊。”

    陆穿还是一脸纠结。

    “这电影票房为什么那么高？”

    谷川笑着说道：“美国人民就喜欢看这些。”

    陆穿嘴角扯了扯。

    感觉美国人民真的是生活在水深火热当中，这种电影，都看的津津有味。

    他突然有了一种责任感，他要给美国人民拍点好电影，让他们吃点细糠。

    谷川说道：“美国的是找女巫，咱们就找僵尸。”

    陆穿眉头皱了皱。

    这也太庸俗了吧。

    他看着谷川问道：“你真的能让电影在美国上映？”

    “包我身上，要是上映不了，我这辈子不找对象！”谷川大包大揽地说道。

    虽然说不找对象，但可以找女朋友、爱人、妻子、老婆。

    “那行。”陆穿说道：“我写个剧本，下部电影就拍这个。”
content_en:
"Taro, why are you in such a hurry to find me?"

    Tanichuan looked at Lu Chuan, a little unhappy.

    He almost helped Taro find an actress, but Lu Chuan called her several times and urged her to come over.

    "Can you please stop calling me Taro?" Lu Chuan said.

    I am not your Japanese classmate.

    "I understand, Taro." Tanichuan nodded.

    Lu Chuan had a toothache.

    Forget it, just call him whatever he wants.

    Lu Chuan started talking about business: "Can "Black Witch" really be called a movie?"

    He had read it and read it several times, feeling like he was wasting his life.

    The picture quality is rough, shot with a handheld DV, and almost the entire film is shaking violently, making you want to vomit.

    The plot is confusing and has no logic.

    But such a movie did achieve a super high box office.

    "Ahem, although this movie has some minor flaws, it cannot be denied that it is an excellent movie." Tanigawa said.

    In Tanigawa's view, if a movie can make money, it is excellent.

    Lu Chuan didn't understand what was so good about this movie.

    "Ahem, he is the originator of mock documentaries. It is normal to be rough." Tanichuan said: "Even if it is as rough as this, the box office is so high. If we shoot better, the box office must not explode."

    Lu Chuan still looked confused.

    "Why is this movie so high at the box office?"

    "That's what the American people like to see," Tanigawa said with a smile.

    Lu Chuan twitched the corners of his mouth.

    It feels like the American people are really living in dire straits, and they all watch this kind of movie with gusto.

    He suddenly felt a sense of responsibility. He wanted to make some good movies for the American people and let them eat some fine chaff.

    Tanigawa said: "The Americans are looking for witches, we are looking for zombies."

    Lu Chuan frowned.

    This is too vulgar.

    He looked at Tanikawa and asked, "Can you really get the movie released in the United States?"

    "It's all about me. If it doesn't come out, I won't be able to find a partner in my life!" Tanichuan said generously.

    Although it is said that you are not looking for a partner, you can find a girlfriend, lover, wife, or wife.

    "That's okay." Lu Chuan said, "I'll write a script and make this next movie."
